For data science AI or backend automation start with Python. If undecided choose JavaScript since it covers frontend backend and mobile with one language. Python is simpler to read and write making it better for complete beginners focused on logic.

Practice on Kaggle competitions. Study scikit-learn for classical ML. Then move to deep learning with PyTorch. Read papers on ArXiv once comfortable with fundamentals. ML is math-heavy so strengthen linear algebra and statistics.

text: Q: How important is a computer science degree for getting a developer job? A: A CS degree helps at large companies like Google and Meta but is not required for most developer roles especially in startups and mid-size companies. text: Q: How do I negotiate a higher salary as a developer? A: Research market rates on LinkedIn Jobs and local job boards. Know your value by benchmarking your skills against job requirements. text: Q: What is RAG and how is it used in AI applications? A: RAG stands for Retrieval Augmented Generation. It combines a retrieval system that fetches relevant documents from a knowledge base with a language model that generates answers grounded in those documents. This prevents hallucination and keeps answers factual. RAG is used in chatbots document Q&A systems and knowledge management tools. It requires a vector database for semantic search and an embedding model to convert text to vectors.

title: What is Docker and why should developers learn it?
text: Q: What is Docker and why should developers learn it? A: Docker is a containerization platform that packages your application with all its dependencies into a portable container. It solves the it works on my machine problem. Every developer should know Docker because it is used in virtually every modern deployment pipeline. Learning Docker takes 1-2 weeks. Start with docker run docker build and docker compose. It is essential for DevOps backend and increasingly frontend development roles.

title: What is system design and when do I need to learn it?
text: Q: What is system design and when do I need to learn it? A: System design is the process of designing scalable distributed systems like how Netflix handles millions of streams or how WhatsApp delivers billions of messages. You need it for senior developer interviews (3+ years experience) and when building systems that must scale. Learn it by studying real-world architectures reading the System Design Primer on GitHub and practicing designing systems like URL shorteners and social media feeds.

title: How do I choose between React Angular and Vue?
text: Q: How do I choose between React Angular and Vue? A: Choose React if you want the largest job market most community resources and flexibility. It is the safest bet for career growth especially in startups. Choose Angular if targeting enterprise companies that already use it — strong TypeScript integration. Choose Vue if joining a team that already uses it or building smaller apps where simplicity matters. React has 60 percent of the market so it maximizes your job options globally and in Bangladesh.
